name: How long does it take for mold to grow behind walls after water damage?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for mold to grow behind walls after water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold can begin to grow behind walls surprisingly quickly after water damage occurs. Under ideal conditions, with sufficient moisture, a food source (like drywall or wood), and a suitable temperature, mold spores can germinate and start to colonize within 24 to 48 hours. Visible growth might take a few days to a week to appear, but the process begins almost immediately. Prompt drying and remediation after any water intrusion are critical to preventing significant mold development.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold can start growing behind walls within 24 to 48 hours after water damage if moisture and food sources are present.
